policy: Receipts cannot self-authorize. Only an owner-authorized entry that binds action, exact collector code revision, product identities, URL inventory, publisher hosts, limits, credential policy, and validity can grant documentation retrieval. Prior AUTH-04, AUTH-PAYLOAD-PILOT, AUTH-METADATA-CHECK and AUTH-METADATA-CHECK-CORRECTED-20260917 do not grant this operation.

entries.basis: Owner instruction 2026-09-17 (navigator increment): new separate documentation-enrichment operation, up to 100 requests / 100 MiB / 10 MiB per response / 30s per request / 2 concurrent (1 per host) / 2 redirect hops / 1 transient retry, no credentials, 7-day validity. This packet materializes that authorization. Routine code corrections may receive additive candidate bindings without resetting the ledger or increasing the budget.
entries.redirect_policy: Redirects must stay within the approved publisher scope. Reject unexpected hosts, private-network destinations, credentials, or out-of-scope content before following or parsing.
entries.retention: Retain document hashes, URLs, retrieval times, relevant excerpts or locators, and typed failures. Store source bytes according to repository evidence/storage rules.
